source: Rhythm spec rewritten 2026-10-13 (american-hotel rework lane) from the measured facades in american-hotel-facades.json: rectified crops of landmark-brief.ts (Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas CC BY 4.0) read on the metre grid of elevation-grid.ts. Each elevation is split into its architectural sections (alongM = metres along the audit's facade frame, from the elevation's left silhouette edge, which the tower drum and the east wing push 4-9 m left of the photographed wall corner) because the sections have their own storey heights: one rhythm per section, never mixed.

facades.name: Leidseplein front: tower and Bar Americain wing (SE)
facades.note: Shopfront under the BAR AMERICAIN canopy, five small round-headed windows (s 1.5-10.1), a storey on three axes (s 3, 6, 9), two upper storeys on the same three axes; the tower drum's windows at the left.

facades.name: Leidseplein front: entrance bay (SE)
facades.note: Entrance arch (s 12.0-17.1) with the door and two side lights; three loggia windows; upper axis s 14.5.

facades.name: Leidseplein front: cafe (SE)
facades.note: Three segmental cafe windows on a 6.05 m pitch (s 20.6, 26.6, 32.6); three loggia windows per arch; two storeys on axes every 3.02 m; dormer windows.

facades.name: Marnixstraat corner pavilion, left bay (NE)
facades.note: One axis: round-headed ground window, four narrow lights, three windows.

facades.name: Marnixstraat corner pavilion, centre bay (NE)
facades.note: Three-light arched window two storeys tall, three loggia windows, two storeys on three axes, six small arched windows, the gable lunette.

facades.name: Marnixstraat corner pavilion, right bay (NE)
facades.note: One axis: round-headed ground window, five narrow lights, three windows.

facades.name: Marnixstraat staircase tower (NE)
facades.note: Door bay and the staircase tower: one arched window per landing, the canted oriel.

facades.name: Marnixstraat main block (NE)
facades.note: 4 double-height ground windows, 4 fan-tracery windows over them, 2 storeys on 7 axes over the stone cornice.

facades.name: Marnixstraat recessed bays (NE)
facades.note: Fifth fan window; 3 tall arched windows on corbelled piers over panels / the door.

facades.name: Leidsekade canal block, 1927 (SW, curved)
facades.note: Ten bays on a 2.34 m pitch: barred basement windows, nine segmental ground windows + the door bay, twenty arcade windows (2 per bay); six canted three-light oriels on 3 storeys.

facades.name: Leidsekade Jugendstil gable front (SW)
facades.note: Five bays (edges 38 + 39): ground windows, paired lights with fanlights, the five-arch arcade, two storeys alternating arched / narrow, four dormer windows, the lunette.

facades.name: Leidsekade corner bay and tower (SW)
facades.note: Entrance, arched windows over the pierced balustrade; the tower drum's window groups.
